02Sound familiar?

You pay for every enquiry. How many become bookings?

Enquiries get lost
“Where did that Magicbricks enquiry go?”

Enquiries come from Facebook, Google, portals, WhatsApp and walk-ins. They end up in emails, Excel sheets and personal phones — and some are never called.

Calls happen too late
“The buyer already booked elsewhere.”

An enquiry waits hours before someone calls. By then the buyer has spoken to three other builders.

No record of talks
“Who spoke to this customer last?”

Everything is in people's heads. When a salesperson leaves, their customers and contacts often leave with them.

Site-visit confusion
“Did the cab reach the customer?”

Visits are arranged over calls and WhatsApp groups. No approval, no trip record, no idea which visits led to a booking.

Old inventory sheets
“Is flat A-402 still available?”

Availability lives in “inventory_final_v3.xlsx”. Salespeople offer flats that are already on hold or sold.

Month-end confusion
“How much is still to be collected?”

Targets, incentives and pending payments are worked out by hand every month — slowly, and with arguments.

    07Step 2 of 7 · Follow up

    Nothing a buyer says is forgotten.

    • Note every call, WhatsApp, visit or email — what the buyer said and how interested they are.
    • Set the next call date, so managers can see who is due today and who is being ignored.
    • Full history for every buyer — if a salesperson leaves, the next one continues smoothly.
    • Hide phone numbers from salespeople — they see 98765 •••••, you see everything. Your contacts stay yours.
